Question B-001-019-004.

Why the correct answer is right: Amateur voice communications may use a maximum of 100% modulation.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "75%": A 75% ceiling would incorrectly make the allowed 75-to-100% range unavailable; the bank sets the maximum at 100%.
- sourceIndex 2: "50%": A 50% ceiling would be only half modulation and is far below the voice maximum in the bank.
- sourceIndex 3: "90%": A 90% ceiling is close enough to be a tempting safety margin, but the regulatory maximum named by the bank is 100%.
